guide.markdown:
# Unclaimed SOL Scanner

Read-only scan of a Solana wallet for SOL locked as rent in dormant token accounts and program buffer accounts, using the Unclaimed SOL API.

## When to Apply

Use when the user:
- Asks about unclaimed SOL, forgotten rent, reclaimable or recoverable SOL, dead token accounts or wallet cleanup.
- Pastes a Solana wallet address and asks what is claimable or recoverable.
- Says "scan wallet", "check claimable", "reclaim SOL", "close token accounts" or "recover rent".

Do not use when:
- The user wants to sign or send a transaction. This skill never builds, signs or submits transactions; claiming happens at https://unclaimedsol.com with a connected wallet.
- The input is a private key, seed phrase or anything other than a base58 public key.

## Trusted Sources

- API: `POST https://unclaimedsol.com/api/check-claimable-sol`
- Claim site: https://unclaimedsol.com
- Fee schedule: https://unclaimedsol.com/fees/
- Privacy policy: https://blog.unclaimedsol.com/privacy-policy/

## Privacy and Consent (required)

The scan sends the user's Solana **public key** to the Unclaimed SOL API over HTTPS. Nothing else is sent. No private keys, seed phrases or signing are involved.

**Before scanning, tell the user their wallet address will be sent to unclaimedsol.com and get their confirmation.** Example:

> To scan your wallet, I'll send your public address to the Unclaimed SOL API at unclaimedsol.com. No private keys are involved, only your public address. Want me to proceed?

## Flow

1. Get the wallet address (base58, 32-44 characters, matching `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$`). If it does not match, ask the user to double-check it.
2. Disclose the API call and wait for consent.
3. Call the API:

```bash
curl -s -f -X POST "https://unclaimedsol.com/api/check-claimable-sol" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"publicKey": "<wallet_address>"}' \
  --max-time 15
```

4. Treat the call as failed unless the body is JSON containing `totalClaimableSol`.
5. Format the result as described below.

## Reading the Response

```json
{
  "totalClaimableSol": 4.728391,
  "assets": 3.921482,
  "buffers": 0.806909,
  "tokenCount": 183,
  "bufferCount": 3
}
```

- `totalClaimableSol`: net SOL reclaimable (assets + buffers), after service fees.
- `assets`: SOL from dormant token accounts (empty accounts, dead memecoins, dust).
- `buffers`: SOL from program buffer accounts.
- `tokenCount` / `bufferCount`: accounts to close. If both are 0 or missing, report only SOL totals, not counts.

Other fields may be present; ignore any you do not need.

Fees: returned totals are net estimates. Standard token cleanup lets the user receive up to 0.002 SOL per account; program buffers carry a 5% fee. The canonical schedule is https://unclaimedsol.com/fees/.

## Formatting

Show the exact SOL value returned. Do not round (4.728391, not 4.73).

If `totalClaimableSol > 0`, report the total and break it down when both types are non-zero:

> Your wallet has **4.728391 SOL** reclaimable.
> - 3.921482 SOL from 183 token accounts
> - 0.806909 SOL from 3 buffer accounts
>
> You can claim at: https://unclaimedsol.com

If only one type has value, show just the total.

If `totalClaimableSol` is 0:

> This wallet has no reclaimable SOL. All accounts are active or already optimized.

Do not tell the user to paste or enter the address on the website; it uses wallet connection, not a search box.

## Rules

- Read-only: no transactions, no keys.
- Never ask for a seed phrase, private key or mnemonic.
- Only accept Solana public keys.
- Always disclose the external API call and get consent before scanning.

executionFlow.title: Scan flow
executionFlow.content:
1. Validate the base58 public key (32-44 characters)
2. Tell the user the address will be sent to unclaimedsol.com and get consent
3. POST {"publicKey": "<wallet>"} to https://unclaimedsol.com/api/check-claimable-sol
4. Report totalClaimableSol at full precision, with the assets/buffers breakdown when both are non-zero

landingGuidance.title: No transactions
landingGuidance.content:
- This skill never builds, signs or sends transactions
- Direct the user to https://unclaimedsol.com and its wallet connection to claim

failureHandling.title: Common failures
failureHandling.content:
- Invalid address format: ask the user to double-check it; do not call the API
- Network error, timeout or a response without totalClaimableSol: say the scan is unavailable right now and suggest connecting the wallet at https://unclaimedsol.com
- Rate limited (HTTP 429): wait before retrying; do not loop
